shots.scene: 欣欣站在一面装满不锈钢细管和接头的气体管路墙前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a lab wall with neat stainless steel gas tubing, small fittings and valves, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲卡套接头和气体管路安全。
overlay: 卡套接头与气体管路安全

shots.scene: 接头、阀门、检漏泡泡、警示牌四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a tube fitting, a small valve, soap bubbles on a joint, and a yellow warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 选得对、装得对、查得勤、处置稳。

shots.scene: 阿杰手拿两个外形不同的接头零件，比划着要拧在一起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds two differently shaped small metal fitting parts and tries to screw them together at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰找了两个不同牌子的零件想拼上。

shots.scene: 两个不同形状的零件拼在一起，接缝处冒出气流图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two mismatched fitting parts joined together with a small gas puff escaping from the seam, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看着能拧上，密封却未必可靠。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指向墙上的管路
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points at the gas tubing on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研说：管路里有压力，不能凑合。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头和仪表阀门是管路的基础
shots.scene: 管路墙特写：细管、卡套接头、小阀门、压力表连成一套
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a lab gas line: thin stainless tubing connected by compression fittings to a small valve and a blank pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 细管、接头、阀门，连成一条气路。
overlay: 卡套接头和仪表阀门是管路的基础

shots.section_title: 卡套接头和仪表阀门是管路的基础
shots.scene: 卡套接头剖面示意图：螺母、卡套、接头体三部分
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a compression tube fitting showing a nut, a ferrule ring and a fitting body around a tube. No people.
shots.narration: 卡套接头靠卡套咬紧管子来密封。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头和仪表阀门是管路的基础
shots.scene: 气体从气瓶经管路流向仪器的箭头示意
shots.prompt_en: An arrow diagram showing gas flowing from a cylinder through tubing and fittings to an analytical instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 输送气体，也连接测量仪表。

shots.section_title: 卡套接头和仪表阀门是管路的基础
shots.scene: 放大镜下精密加工的零件图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a precisely machined fitting icon with fine threads. No people.
shots.narration: 零件小，但对精度要求很高。

shots.section_title: 很多行业都离不开它们
shots.scene: 工厂、化工厂、造纸厂、芯片、飞机五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: an oil rig, a chemical plant, a paper mill, a microchip and an airplane. No people.
shots.narration: 油气、化工、造纸、半导体、航空都在用。
overlay: 很多行业都离不开它们

shots.section_title: 很多行业都离不开它们
shots.scene: 实验室里连着气相色谱仪的气路
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench with a gas chromatograph connected to thin gas lines from the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实验室的气路里，也到处是它们。

shots.section_title: 高要求领域有专门的质量要求
shots.scene: 火箭图标旁有一张盖章的空白证书
shots.prompt_en: A rocket icon next to a blank certificate with a round seal stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 航空航天等领域，对质量要求极高。
overlay: 高要求领域有专门的质量要求

shots.section_title: 高要求领域有专门的质量要求
shots.scene: 零件经过多道检查关卡的流程图标
shots.prompt_en: A flow icon of a fitting passing through several inspection checkpoints with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 供应商要通过专门的质量体系审核。

shots.section_title: 不同厂家部件不能想当然混用
shots.scene: 两个外形略有不同的接头部件，中间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Two slightly different fitting parts side by side with a large question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 不同厂家的部件，能不能互换？
overlay: 不同厂家部件不能想当然混用

shots.section_title: 不同厂家部件不能想当然混用
shots.scene: 一份带印章的空白文件和一份测试报告图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document with a seal stamp next to a blank test report with a chart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要看厂家书面保证和第三方测试。

shots.section_title: 不同厂家部件不能想当然混用
shots.scene: 同一套颜色的螺母、卡套、接头体打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a nut, ferrule and fitting body all in the same color set with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，同一接头最好用同一套部件。

shots.section_title: 选用经过认证的合格产品
shots.scene: 零件包装盒上贴着空白合格证
shots.prompt_en: A small parts box with a blank certificate label and a check mark seal on it. No people.
shots.narration: 选用经过第三方认证的合格产品。
overlay: 选用经过认证的合格产品

shots.section_title: 选用经过认证的合格产品
shots.scene: 零件旁一条追溯链图标连到工厂
shots.prompt_en: A fitting icon linked by a chain of dots to a factory icon and a blank document. No people.
shots.narration: 有合格证明，来源可以追溯。

shots.scene: 生产线上零件逐个经过检测仪，旁边是折线图
shots.prompt_en: A production line where fittings pass under an inspection camera one by one, with a simple line chart beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 生产中实时监控，质量才稳定。

shots.scene: 老周带着阿杰核对一张空白采购单
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student check a blank purchase form together at a desk.
shots.narration: 管路元件要走正规渠道采购。

shots.scene: 来路不明的散装零件被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A pile of loose unlabeled fittings in a plain bag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 来路不明的零件，不要装上气路。

shots.section_title: 气瓶、容器与管路的法规要求
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白法规手册，旁边是气瓶和储罐图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank law booklet next to icons of a gas cylinder and a pressure tank.
shots.narration: 气瓶和压力容器属于特种设备。
overlay: 气瓶、容器与管路的法规要求

shots.section_title: 气瓶、容器与管路的法规要求
shots.scene: 王老师在空白屏幕前讲解，屏幕上是气瓶、储罐、管道图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains in front of a blank screen showing icons of a cylinder, a tank and a pipeline.
shots.narration: 要按国家规定和本校制度管理。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研、阿杰做培训，桌上有空白证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains the female graduate student and the young male student, with a blank certificate on the table.
shots.narration: 接管路前，先参加培训并获得授权。

shots.scene: 老李在气路旁示范，学生在旁观看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer demonstrates at a gas line panel while the two students watch.
shots.narration: 不会就请老李这样的专业人员来做。

shots.scene: 老李翻阅空白说明书，旁边摆着专用扳手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reads a blank installation manual with a proper wrench set laid out beside it.
shots.narration: 安装要照说明书，用合适的工具。

shots.scene: 管子切口整齐、插到底的示意图，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cleanly cut tube fully inserted into a fitting body, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 管口平整，管子插到底，再拧紧。

shots.scene: 管子没插到底、管口毛刺的示意图，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a tube with a rough burred end only half inserted into a fitting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 管子没插到底，接头就可能漏。

shots.scene: 老李用小刷子在接头处涂检漏液
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer brushes leak detection solution onto a fitting joint with a small brush.
shots.narration: 装好后，用检漏液逐个检查接头。

shots.scene: 接头处冒出一串小泡泡
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a fitting joint with a cluster of small soap bubbles forming. No people.
shots.narration: 冒泡就是漏气，要处理后再用。

shots.scene: 打火机靠近接头的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lighter flame held near a gas fitting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用明火找漏点。

shots.section_title: 压力管路不得带压拆卸
shots.scene: 扳手拧向一个连着压力表的接头，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench loosening a fitting on a pressurized line with a blank gauge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 管路有压力时，不得拆卸或紧固。
overlay: 压力管路不得带压拆卸

shots.section_title: 压力管路不得带压拆卸
shots.scene: 老李关闭气瓶阀和管路阀，看着压力表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the cylinder valve and the line valve, then watches the blank gauge needle drop.
shots.narration: 先关气源，安全泄压，再动接头。

shots.section_title: 管路要标明介质和流向
shots.scene: 墙上的管路贴着空白色带和流向箭头
shots.prompt_en: Gas lines on the wall with colored blank identification bands and flow direction arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 每条管路都要标明气体名称和流向。
overlay: 管路要标明介质和流向

shots.section_title: 管路要标明介质和流向
shots.scene: 并排的几个气瓶，颜色各不相同
shots.prompt_en: Several gas cylinders of different body colors chained upright to a wall rack. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶颜色标志按国家标准识别。

shots.scene: 小研闻到异味，立即关闭管路阀门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notices a hissing gas line and immediately closes the line valve.
shots.narration: 发现泄漏，能安全关阀就先关阀。

shots.scene: 打开的窗户和排风扇图标，开关和火焰图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open window and an exhaust fan, next to a light switch and a flame icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通风，可燃气体泄漏不碰电器明火。

shots.scene: 小研带阿杰撤到走廊，向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student out to the corridor and reports to the older man.
shots.narration: 人员撤离，报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 火情拨打119，有人受伤拨打120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现合格证、接头和检漏泡泡图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a certificate, a fitting and soap bubbles.
shots.narration: 选合格件，不混用，按说明书装。

shots.scene: 检漏、关阀泄压、标识三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a bubbling joint, a closed valve with a gauge at zero, and a labeled pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 装后检漏，带压不拆，标识清楚。

shots.scene: 关阀、通风、撤离、报告四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a closed valve, an open window, a running person to an exit, and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏时关阀、通风、撤离、报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的管路墙前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy, labeled gas line wall.
shots.narration: 管路连得牢，实验才安心，下次见！
